links.outcome: SOAP medication log quality, measured by BERT score, ROUGE and blinded expert 7DI evaluation
links.effect: Multi-source input (dialogue plus patient information, records and test results) was superior on both machine scores and manual 7DI evaluation; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Output quality remained highly dependent on input data completeness; hallucinations and incomplete analyses still occurred
links.quote: Both machine scores and manual 7DI evaluation confirmed the superiority of multi-source inputs over single-source dialogues.

design_hint: prompt engineering and pharmacist review of LLM outputs
